run_train_reader: run the FiDT5 reader training script with T5 model on a dataset using argparse options
train_FiDT5_model: train a FiDT5 model with gradient accumulation, evaluation, and checkpoint saving
evaluate_model_exact_match: evaluate a FiDT5 model on a dataset and compute exact match scores
load_checkpoint_resume_training: load a FiDT5 model checkpoint and resume training from a saved step
setup_distributed_training: set up distributed data parallel training for FiDT5 across multiple GPUs
